newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil August 21-31 IGP-M index drops 0.13 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil August 21-31 IGP-M index drops 0.13 pct.

text.p: Brazilian inflation between August 21 and 31 dropped 0.13 percent, against a 0.54 percent rise between July 21 and 31 as measured by the IGP-M index released by the Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV).
The IGP-M is composed of three other economic indicators.

They are the IPA wholesale price index, which dropped 0.01 percent in the period, the IPC consumer price index, which fell 0.40 percent, and the INCC national index of construction costs, which rose 0.10 percent.
The IPA has a 60 percent weighting in the IGP-M, the IPC a 30 percent weighting and the INCC 10 percent, the FGV said.
The IGP-M index, which measures inflation over ten-day intervals, is published by the independent research institute Fundacao Getulio Vargas (FGV).
